[[File:Salvagers-DE1-P01.jpg|thumb|right|A scavenger team including Brick and Slag.]]
'''Slag''' was a member of a [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] party in the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Civil War]].

==Biography==
Slag was of a nervous disposition, and his friend [[Brick (scavenger)|Brick]] often had to keep his morale up with a combination of reassurances and taunts.<ref name="SW:DEa">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>

The two of them were part of a scavenger crew that attempted to raid the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] when it landed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to rescue the crew of the [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Liberator'']].
When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] tried to secure his ship, Brick released a pack of [[Nek/Legends|neks]], which [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] stopped with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="SW:DEa" /><ref name="DE1">[[Dark Empire 1|''Dark Empire'' 1]]</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Slag and Brick were created for the ''Dark Empire'' audio drama, and based on their dialogue it can be definitively stated that they are among the scavengers atop the ''Millennium Falcon'' in the first issue of the ''Dark Empire'' comic series.
